title: AddFieldResult
description: Output of `rulekit add-field` — the summary of the field added. The modified model is written back to the file (in place, or -o); --dry-run writes nothing.

added.description: the full name-path of the field that was added

kind.description: the field kind: STRING | NUMBER | DATE | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM

written.description: true if written to disk; false under --dry-run
